messages:
aisha_sales: hey team — customer (EU bank) asking if we can guarantee "data stays in EU" for a short POC. they also want all egress traffic to be tagged for their billing and to know which subprocessors are in the path. what are the quick answers we can give?

tom_solutions: short: yes for storage/compute if we pin them to EU region & use Private deployment or Dedicated in eu-west. tagging + subproc list need a bit more detail. do we have a prebuilt answer doc? :thinking_face:

mina_security: @aisha_sales we should ask whether they mean "no cross-border telemetry" or just "customer data". we send some anonymized metrics to our control plane by default — that currently crosses to our control plane region (us-east). can we confirm if that's acceptable?

aisha_sales: they specifically said "no customer payload leaves EU" and want control-plane telemetry minimized. they said telemetry to control plane is ok if it's scrubbed/aggregated, but need confirmation on KMS and subprocessors.

eli_netops: for Dedicated/Private we can keep model inference and unencrypted artifacts in region. KMS: if they BYOK with a customer key in an EU KMS, keys never leave. if they want our managed KMS, keys may be in eu-west but backups replicate depending on config — need to confirm backup policy. quick firewall: we can route egress via regional NATs and advertise ASN in case they want IP allowlist.

jin_engineering: technical flag-wise: for POC we can enable tenant_pin_region: "eu-west-1" + egress_affinity: strict + control_plane_minimal_telemetry: true. sample config snippet we send to ops:

```json
{
  "tenant_pin_region": "eu-west-1",
  "egress_affinity": "strict",
  "kms_mode": "customer_managed",
  "telemetry_level": "aggregated"
}
```

mina_security: subprocessors: short list for eu-west: cloud-provider-netops, cdn-provider (eu nodes), metrics-aggregator (we use a third-party aggregator but can toggle off for Private). i can paste formal attestation but need to check the latest contract with the aggregator.

aisha_sales: do we have an answer re: whether any model artifacts or calls will hit non-EU endpoints (e.g., model catalog fetching, fallback to us models)? customer wants no silent fallbacks.

jin_engineering: we can pin model versions and disable auto-fallback. set model_fallback_policy: "disabled" for the tenant. that way all requests either succeed on EU hosts or error. ops note: this increases failure modes in rare overload.

tom_solutions: pricing question from customer: they asked if EU-only routing increases cost vs default. what's the delta ballpark for POC (1M tokens / month)?

eli_netops: routing delta = egress + reserved eu capacity. for 1M tokens: ~+15-25% on token compute cost (depends on model family) + potential egress fees if they require cross-region peering. I'll ask finance for a ballpark. :money_with_wings:

mina_security: also note: disabling telemetry and aggregator increases our operational overhead for debugging POC issues — we should flag that to the customer as a tradeoff.

aisha_sales: timeline: customer wants POC within 2 weeks. what do we need from them to fast-track?

jin_engineering: ask for:
- exact EU region preference (eu-west-1 or eu-central-1)
- BYOK intent (yes/no) + KMS ARN if yes
- list of IP ranges to allowlist
- decision on model_fallback_policy

tom_solutions: I'll send a short checklist to the customer by EOD. @mina_security can you prepare the subprocessors bullet list and a short attestation we can attach? ideally <48h.

mina_security: yes — I'll pull the latest attestation and flag any non-EU telemetry connectors. will share in #sales after review.

deploy-bot: Deploy job 2942 triggered by jin_engineering — region pin config test started on eu-west-1 staging cluster.

aisha_sales: awesome. last Q: are there any legal docs we should preemptively share (DPA/SSC) or special wording for their procurement team?

tom_solutions: share standard DPA + subproc addendum, and include the attestation. if they request SOC/ISO copies, we can route to legal. i'll cc legal if they escalate.

aisha_sales: perfect. thanks everyone — i'll update customer and push checklist.
